/** Convert browser pointer coordinates to internal canvas pixels after CSS scaling. */
export function pointerToCanvas(clientX, clientY, rectangle, width, height) {
  return {
    x: (clientX - rectangle.left) * width / rectangle.width,
    y: (clientY - rectangle.top) * height / rectangle.height
  };
}

/** Load the supplied aiming artwork without changing project image files. */
function loadAimImage(source) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${source}.`));
    image.src = source;
  });
}

/** Manage independent arrow visibility and click-to-toggle cursor aiming. */
export function createAiming(canvas) {
  const toggle = document.querySelector('#toggle-arrow');
  const modeLabel = document.querySelector('#aim-mode');
  const state = { visible: true, cursorAim: false, inside: false, pointer: { x: 0, y: 0 } };
  let arrow;
  let crosshair;

  // EDIT these values to tune the aiming sprites in internal canvas pixels.
  const arrowWidth = 58;
  const arrowHeight = 31;
  const crosshairSize = 32;
  const ready = Promise.all([
    loadAimImage('../sprites/arrow.png'),
    loadAimImage('../sprites/crosshair.png')
  ]).then(images => { [arrow, crosshair] = images; });

  /** Keep UI and native cursor in sync with the selected aiming mode. */
  function updateControls() {
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.visible));
    toggle.textContent = state.visible ? 'Arrow: shown' : 'Arrow: hidden';
    modeLabel.textContent = state.cursorAim ? 'Aim: crosshair' : 'Aim: character facing';
    canvas.style.cursor = state.cursorAim && state.inside ? 'none' : 'default';
  }

  /** Track the pointer in screen space, so camera scrolling cannot offset aiming. */
  function trackPointer(event) {
    state.pointer = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
    state.inside = true;
    updateControls();
  }

  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.visible = !state.visible;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerenter', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    state.inside = false;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    trackPointer(event);
    state.cursorAim = !state.cursorAim;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Draw an upward-native arrow rotated toward facing or the custom cursor. */
  function draw(context, character, cameraX, vector) {
    if (!arrow || !crosshair) return;
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y;
    let dx = vector[0];
    let dy = vector[1];
    if (state.cursorAim) {
      dx = state.pointer.x - x;
      dy = state.pointer.y - y;
      // Preserve facing if the cursor is precisely on the character anchor.
      if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) [dx, dy] = vector;
    }
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    if (state.visible) {
      const distance = (character.spriteSize || 130) / 2 + 25;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x + Math.cos(angle) * distance, y + Math.sin(angle) * distance);
      context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
      context.drawImage(arrow, -arrowWidth / 2, -arrowHeight / 2, arrowWidth, arrowHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
    if (state.cursorAim && state.inside) {
      context.drawImage(crosshair,
        state.pointer.x - crosshairSize / 2, state.pointer.y - crosshairSize / 2,
        crosshairSize, crosshairSize);
    }
  }

  /** Return to facing-based aiming without overriding the visibility preference. */
  function reset() {
    state.cursorAim = false;
    updateControls();
  }

  updateControls();
  return { ready, draw, reset, state };
}

import { rememberEnemy, getAllEnemies, getEnemy, removeEnemy, clearEnemies, getVisibleEnemies } from './world-state.js';
import { pointerToCanvas } from './aiming.js';

/** Install session-only NPC spawning, inspection, deletion, and basic test AI. */
export function createNpcTools({ canvas, characters, camera, getPlayer, updateCharacter, drawCharacter }) {
  const panel = document.querySelector('#npc-tools');
  const field = name => panel.querySelector(`[name="${name}"]`);
  const list = field('npc-selection');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#npc-feedback');
  let counter = 0;
  let selectedId = '';
  let paused = false;
  let step = false;
  const cap = 200; // EDIT maximum session population to protect preview responsiveness.

  /** Refresh selection only when population changes, retaining the current ID. */
  function refresh() {
    list.replaceChildren();
    for (const npc of getAllEnemies()) {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = npc.id;
      option.textContent = `${npc.id} / ${npc.label}`;
      list.append(option);
    }
    if (!getEnemy(selectedId)) selectedId = getAllEnemies()[0]?.id || '';
    list.value = selectedId;
    feedback.textContent = `${getAllEnemies().length} NPCs / limit ${cap}. Session-only state.`;
  }

  /** Clone an animation configuration into independent world-space NPC state. */
  function spawn(x, y) {
    if (getAllEnemies().length >= cap) {
      feedback.textContent = `Population limit (${cap}) reached. Delete NPCs before spawning more.`;
      return;
    }
    const type = field('npc-type').value;
    const template = characters[type];
    const size = template.spriteSize || 130;
    const npc = rememberEnemy(`npc-${++counter}`, {
      ...template, type, x, y: Math.max(size / 2, Math.min(canvas.height - size / 2, y)),
      direction: template.defaultDirection || 'down', facing: template.defaultDirection || 'left',
      moving: false, elapsed: 0, attack: null, transition: null, lastPose: null,
      movementSpeedMultiplier: 0.8, // All test NPCs use 144 px/s, 60% of player speed.
      ai: field('npc-ai').checked, behavior: field('npc-behavior').value,
      wanderTimer: 0, wanderDirection: undefined, hp: 100, maxHp: 100
    });
    selectedId = npc.id;
  }

  /** Spawn a bounded batch in the current visible world area. */
  function spawnBatch(position) {
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, Number(field('npc-count').value) || 1));
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      spawn(position ? position.x : camera.x + 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.width - 280),
        position ? position.y : 140 + Math.random() * Math.max(0, canvas.height - 280));
    }
    refresh();
  }

  panel.querySelector('#spawn-npc').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (field('npc-mode').value === 'random') spawnBatch();
    else feedback.textContent = 'Cursor spawn armed: left-click inside the game screen. Choose Inspect to stop spawning.';
  });
  list.addEventListener('change', () => { selectedId = list.value; });

  // Capture before aiming's click handler. NPC tool clicks never toggle aiming.
  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    const mode = field('npc-mode').value;
    if (mode === 'random') return;
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    const point = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
    point.x += camera.x;
    if (mode === 'cursor') spawnBatch(point);
    else {
      const closest = getAllEnemies().filter(npc =>
        Math.hypot(npc.x - point.x, npc.y - point.y) < (npc.spriteSize || 130) / 2
      ).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - point.x, a.y - point.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - point.x, b.y - point.y))[0];
      if (closest) {
        selectedId = closest.id;
        if (mode === 'delete') removeEnemy(selectedId);
        refresh();
      }
    }
  }, true);

  /** Dispatch selected-NPC and population actions from the admin panel. */
  panel.querySelectorAll('[data-npc-action]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const npc = getEnemy(selectedId);
      switch (button.dataset.npcAction) {
        case 'delete': if (npc) removeEnemy(npc.id); break;
        case 'clear': clearEnemies(); break;
        case 'delete-visible':
          for (const entry of getVisibleEnemies(camera.x, canvas.width, 0)) removeEnemy(entry.id);
          break;
        case 'apply-ai':
          if (npc) { npc.ai = field('npc-ai').checked; npc.behavior = field('npc-behavior').value; }
          break;
        case 'all-ai-on': for (const entry of getAllEnemies()) entry.ai = true; break;
        case 'all-ai-off': for (const entry of getAllEnemies()) entry.ai = false; break;
        case 'damage': if (npc) { npc.hp = Math.max(0, npc.hp - 25); if (!npc.hp) removeEnemy(npc.id); } break;
        case 'heal': if (npc) npc.hp = npc.maxHp; break;
        case 'bring': if (npc) { npc.x = getPlayer().x + 160; npc.y = getPlayer().y; } break;
        case 'pause': paused = !paused; button.textContent = paused ? 'Resume AI' : 'Pause AI'; break;
        case 'step': step = true; paused = true; panel.querySelector('[data-npc-action="pause"]').textContent = 'Resume AI'; break;
      }
      refresh();
    });
  });

  /** Advance simple chase/wander AI; records stay alive even when off-screen. */
  function update(delta) {
    const time = step ? 1 / 60 : paused ? 0 : delta;
    step = false;
    const player = getPlayer();
    const names = ['up', 'upRight', 'right', 'downRight', 'down', 'downLeft', 'left', 'upLeft'];
    for (const npc of getAllEnemies()) {
      let direction;
      if (time && npc.ai) {
        if (npc.behavior === 'chase') {
          const dx = player.x - npc.x, dy = player.y - npc.y;
          if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 65) {
            const angle = Math.atan2(dx, -dy);
            direction = names[(Math.round(angle / (Math.PI / 4)) + 8) % 8];
          }
        } else if (npc.behavior === 'wander') {
          npc.wanderTimer -= time;
          if (npc.wanderTimer <= 0) {
            npc.wanderTimer = 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.5;
            npc.wanderDirection = names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)];
          }
          direction = npc.wanderDirection;
        }
      }
      if (time) updateCharacter(npc, time, direction);
    }
    const selected = getEnemy(selectedId);
    document.querySelector('#npc-inspector').textContent = selected
      ? `${selected.id} | X ${selected.x.toFixed(1)} Y ${selected.y.toFixed(1)} | HP ${selected.hp}/${selected.maxHp} | AI ${selected.ai ? selected.behavior : 'off'}`
      : 'No NPC selected.';
  }

  /** Cull rendering only; show optional bounds/health and selected-NPC highlight. */
  function draw(context) {
    for (const npc of getVisibleEnemies(camera.x, canvas.width, 300).sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y)) {
      drawCharacter(npc);
      if (field('npc-debug').checked || npc.id === selectedId) {
        const size = npc.spriteSize || 130;
        context.save();
        context.strokeStyle = npc.id === selectedId ? '#ffdf55' : '#ff749f';
        context.lineWidth = 2;
        context.strokeRect(npc.x - camera.x - size / 2, npc.y - size / 2, size, size);
        context.fillStyle = '#142e46';
        context.fillRect(npc.x - camera.x - 30, npc.y - size / 2 - 12, 60, 5);
        context.fillStyle = '#60e4a7';
        context.fillRect(npc.x - camera.x - 30, npc.y - size / 2 - 12, 60 * npc.hp / npc.maxHp, 5);
        context.restore();
      }
    }
  }

  refresh();
  return { update, draw };
}
